system.description: Mental fortitude. The capacity to keep functioning when the situation is overwhelming - when what you have just seen is incomprehensible, when the task is endless, when hope is genuinely difficult to locate. Resolve is not the absence of fear or grief; it is the ability to continue despite them. In a setting where the scale of loss is total and unrelenting, Resolve is the skill that keeps a character operational. It is the counterpart to Endure, which covers the body; Resolve covers the mind.
system.overcome: Use Resolve to push through fear, panic, or despair in the moment; to hold together under sustained psychological pressure; to keep functioning in the aftermath of a mental or emotional shock; to resist coercion, interrogation, or the slow erosion of hope.
system.caa: You can use Resolve to place aspects on yourself, representing a state of deep concentration or focus.
system.defend: Resolve defends against mental attacks and social actions designed to intimidate, demoralise, or psychologically destabilise. It is also the primary defence against horror - the moment of confronting something that the human mind is not designed to process.
